studio_id.description: The Studio's own id (a uuid it makes once, §2.8.9). Encore ties every outbox item to it.

auto_make.description: §2.2b: may this player ask for party auto-make now (the Studio's admin turned it on and allowed this player), and about how many minutes a song asked for now takes until it's published (null when not allowed or no graphics card is up). A Studio from before auto-make leaves it out: not allowed.
